title: 🔥 THE TRUTH AND LIES ABOUT GUARDIAN ANGELS – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE TRUTH AND LIES ABOUT GUARDIAN ANGELS – WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY? 🔥
📖 Hebrews 1:14 – "Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?"

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I’ve always been told that everyone has a personal ‘guardian angel’ watching over them. Some people even pray to their guardian angels for protection. Is this true? What does the Bible really say about guardian angels?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people have grown up believing in guardian angels, but most of what is taught today is based on tradition, Hollywood movies, and false teachings—not the Bible!
🚨 Let’s separate biblical truth from deception and expose the lies about guardian angels!

🔥 1. BIBLICAL TRUTH: ANGELS ARE REAL AND THEY SERVE GOD!
📖 Psalm 91:11 – "For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways."
🔥 YES! The Bible clearly teaches that angels exist, and they serve God’s purposes!

✔️ Angels are messengers of God. (Luke 1:26 – "The angel Gabriel was sent by God.")
✔️ Angels protect God’s people. (2 Kings 6:16-17 – Elisha’s servant saw an army of angels protecting them!)
✔️ Angels fight spiritual battles. (Daniel 10:13 – The angel Michael fought against demonic forces!)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
When Peter was in prison, an angel appeared and freed him from chains! (Acts 12:7-10)
👉 Angels are powerful servants of God, sent to fulfill His divine will!
🚨 BUT NOWHERE DOES THE BIBLE SAY WE EACH HAVE A "PERSONAL" GUARDIAN ANGEL!

🔥 2. LIE: EVERY PERSON HAS A PERSONAL "GUARDIAN ANGEL"
📖 Matthew 18:10 – "See that you do not despise one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven."
🔥 Some people misunderstand this verse and assume it means every person has a guardian angel—but that is NOT what Jesus said!

✔️ Jesus did not say "their angels protect them"—He said they stand before God.
✔️ Angels are assigned by God according to His will, not to every person individually.
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does it say every person has a specific angel following them.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If every person had a personal guardian angel, why didn’t Paul’s angel protect him from being beaten, shipwrecked, or imprisoned?
👉 Because angels are NOT assigned to serve human desires, but God’s divine plan!
🚨 THERE IS NO BIBLICAL EVIDENCE THAT EVERY HUMAN HAS A PERSONAL GUARDIAN ANGEL!

🔥 3. LIE: WE SHOULD PRAY TO ANGELS FOR HELP
📖 Colossians 2:18 – "Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you."
🔥 NOWHERE in the Bible does it say we should pray to angels!

❌ Angels are NOT God. (Exodus 20:3 – "You shall have no other gods before Me.")
❌ Angels are NOT mediators. (1 Timothy 2:5 – "There is one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus.")
❌ Angels themselves REFUSE worship! (Revelation 22:8-9 – An angel told John, "Do not worship me! Worship God!")

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Some people pray, “Dear Guardian Angel, protect me!”
👉 But the Bible says we should pray to GOD ALONE! (Matthew 6:9)
🚨 PRAYING TO ANGELS IS A DEMONIC DECEPTION—ONLY GOD ANSWERS PRAYER!

🔥 4. LIE: DEAD LOVED ONES BECOME GUARDIAN ANGELS
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."
🔥 Humans and angels are COMPLETELY DIFFERENT creations!

❌ Humans DO NOT become angels after death. (Psalm 8:5 – "You have made them [humans] a little lower than the angels.")
❌ Angels were created BEFORE humans. (Job 38:4-7 – Angels witnessed the creation of the world!)
❌ Once a person dies, they go to judgment—not to become an angel!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If your grandmother passes away, she does not become your guardian angel.
👉 She either goes to be with Christ (if saved) or faces judgment (if unsaved).
🚨 LOVED ONES DO NOT BECOME ANGELS AFTER DEATH—THIS IS A FALSE TEACHING!

🔥 5. THE REAL PURPOSE OF ANGELS ACCORDING TO THE BIBLE
📖 Hebrews 1:14 – "Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?"
🔥 Angels are messengers and warriors who serve GOD—not us!

✔️ Angels execute God’s commands. (Psalm 103:20 – "Bless the Lord, O you His angels, who do His word!")
✔️ Angels rejoice when sinners repent. (Luke 15:10 – "There is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.")
✔️ Angels will accompany Jesus at His return. (Matthew 25:31 – "When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.")

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
When Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, angels came to minister to Him! (Matthew 4:11)
👉 Angels exist to serve GOD and His divine plan—not to be our personal bodyguards!
🚨 ANGELS FOLLOW GOD’S WILL, NOT HUMAN REQUESTS!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DO NOT BE DECEIVED BY FALSE TEACHINGS ABOUT ANGELS!
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 – "Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light."
🚨 SATAN USES FALSE TEACHINGS ABOUT ANGELS TO DISTRACT PEOPLE FROM JESUS!

🔥 WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
❌ Do not pray to angels.
❌ Do not worship angels.
❌ Do not believe Hollywood lies about angels.
✔️ Trust in JESUS CHRIST alone—He is the ONLY Savior!

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Biblical truth about angels?
❌ Or false traditions that lead to deception?
🚨 CHOOSE WISELY—THE TRUTH WILL SET YOU FREE!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR DISCERNMENT
"Lord Jesus, I repent for believing lies about angels. I choose to trust Your Word over man-made traditions. Keep me away from deception, and help me worship You alone. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
